newsitem.title: USA: Innovir considering other means of finance.
newsitem.headline: Innovir considering other means of finance.

text.p: Innovir Laboratories Inc said Thursday it is considering other means of financing, and its cash position at the end of the second quarter is equal to less than one year of expenses at the current expense rate.
In addition, the company said the exercise of warrants by VIMRx Pharmaceuticals Inc and Aries Funds will provide it with an additional $2 million.
The company reported a loss per share for the second quarter of $0.14 per share versus a loss per share of $0.35 for the same period a year ago.
Cash and short term investments at June 30 were $1.8 million versus $6.4 million at December 31, 1996.
